why: The first attempt used `length` as the index, which is out of bounds. After the hint, the student reasoned that the last index is `length - 1`, so next-to-last is `length - 2`. They then wrote correct code, `sensorReadings[sensorReadings.length - 2] = 7.9;`. This links `length` to the index rule for this one task and does not go beyond it, and the hint was needed, so it is L3 and not L4.
